title: Ever Works templates listing manifest
description: Schema for `manifest.json` in the template listing repository `ever-works/templates`. Covers BOTH website templates and app templates (kind discriminator). Hand-authored; validated in CI. This file is the listing, not the resolution source of truth: the platform discovers templates by scanning the catalog organization for repositories whose name ends in `template` and reads each repository's own `.works/template.yml` and `.works/works.yml`.

catalogOrganization.description: The GitHub organization the platform scans for `-template` repositories (config.websiteTemplate.getCatalogOrganization()).

templates.description: One row per template repository we keep. ≤ 1000 rows; `slug` unique.

appSources.description: Repositories that template rows refer to as their app source but that are NOT templates themselves (their name does not end in `template`).

everWorksRepo.description: `owner/name` inside the catalog organization. Security: the platform only ever forks repositories in this organization, so a hostile or forked manifest cannot make it clone attacker-controlled code (SAFE_REPO_RE, apps/api/src/works/works-template-catalog.service.ts:114).

githubRepo.description: Any `owner/name` on the Git provider — used only for upstream/app-source coordinates, which the platform never fetches as code.

source.description: Where the classification comes from: the template repository's own LICENSE, the upstream project, or the app-source repository.

repo.description: Owner/name of the template repository to fork or generate from. Must be null only while status is `placeholder`.

ref.description: Branch to fork from, or the release tag `v<blueprint.version>` for an app template. Ignored when sha is set.

sha.description: Pinned commit, 40 lower-case hex. Required for every non-placeholder row — the platform applies the sha, never a branch. This is the plan's `blueprint.sha` (APW-03 catalog.md §3.1); it is not duplicated elsewhere in the row.

isGitHubTemplate.description: True when the repository is marked as a GitHub template repository (generate-from-template); false for a plain fork/clone.

aliases.description: Former names (renames and transfers), matched case-insensitively.

blueprint.description: The catalogue identity of an app template. `version` is the semver a tag `v<version>` in the template repository must carry; the commit that tag points to is `template.sha`.

appSource.description: Where the application source lives. `embedded` = it is the template repository itself (code-bearing); `repository` = a separate repository the user also forks (metadata-only); `image` = a published container image and no app-source repository (single fork).

kind.description: `website` — a Website/Work Template (the existing ever-works template family). `app` — an App Blueprint (the platform builds, runs and evolves the fork).

status.description: `placeholder` rows name repositories that do not exist yet (sha may be null); `beta` and `production` rows must name a real, pinned, public repository.

role.description: The persisted RepositoryRole the template's output feeds. Always `website` — the Work Repository. No new role value exists or is added (packages/contracts/src/api/work/import-source.dto.ts:12).

workRepositorySuffix.description: Suffix for the Work Repository's name when this template is used: `-app` for an app template, `-website` for a website template (and the unchanged default). Suffix only — the role stays `website`.

shape.description: App templates only. `code-bearing`: the template repository holds the application source (kept in sync as a public fork of the upstream project with our metadata added) — provisioning forks one repository. `metadata-only`: the template holds only our metadata — provisioning forks the template AND the app-source repository.

upstreams.description: App templates only: the upstream repositories this template serves (1–5).

managedHosting.description: App templates only. `allowed: true` for an amber-licensed upstream only with a recorded agreement (CONTRACTS R-3).

allOf.comment: An app row that is not a placeholder must pin a 40-hex commit: the platform applies the sha, never a branch (APW-03 catalog.md §3.1). Website templates keep the existing branch-fork behaviour (ref, sha null).

servesTemplates.description: Slugs of the template rows this repository is the app source for.

githubTemplateRepository.description: GitHub's template-repository setting. NOT a statement about App Blueprints — see the fixture conflation note in README.md §7.
